title: E2B Agent Sandboxes: The Space to Place your Claude Agents
description:
Reddit ROASTED my landing page - and they were absolutely right. So I did what any self-respecting AI engineer would do: I deployed NINE parallel agent sandboxes to fix it. 🔥

This is the FUTURE of agentic coding and it's happening RIGHT NOW.

🚀 Agent sandboxes are changing the game for agentic coding and AI sandbox environments. In this video, I show you how to scale your AI coding impact by deploying multiple agents in parallel using E2B sandbox technology. Watch as I transform Reddit criticism into nine different landing page solutions using Claude Code and an orchestrator agent.

💡 What makes agent sandboxes revolutionary? Instead of prompting back and forth with a single agent, you can deploy multiple agents working in parallel - each in their own isolated E2B environment. This is how you scale your compute to scale your impact. I demonstrate the power of the "best of n" pattern, where we solve one problem multiple times with different agents to get the optimal solution.

🛠️ In this tactical agentic coding demonstration, you'll learn how to set up an orchestrator agent that manages multiple agent sandboxes. I walk through the complete workflow: extracting actionable feedback from Reddit, converting it into concrete prompts using context engineering and prompt engineering techniques, then deploying those prompts across nine parallel Claude Code agents running in isolated E2B sandbox environments.

🔥 This is IndyDevDan bringing you edge content on AI coding, agentic coding, and the future of software engineering. Whether you're learning principled AI coding or tactical agentic coding, understanding agent sandboxes is crucial. Fortune 100 companies are already using this technology - tools like Manus, ChatGPT, and Claude all run on isolated agent environments when executing code.

⚡ Key insights covered:
- How agent sandboxes provide isolation, scale, and agency for your AI coding workflows
- Building an orchestrator agent to manage multiple agent sandboxes
- Using E2B sandbox technology to deploy agents at scale
- The "best of n" pattern for generating multiple solutions in parallel
- Practical prompt engineering and context engineering for agentic coding
- Scaling your compute with Claude Code and parallel agent execution
- Why Fortune 100 companies are investing in AI sandbox infrastructure

🌟 Agent sandboxes give your agents three critical capabilities: isolation (dedicated safe environments), scale (parallel execution across multiple instances), and agency (full autonomous control). This is the natural evolution of agentic coding - from single-agent workflows to orchestrated multi-agent systems running in dedicated environments.

💼 Ready to level up your agentic coding skills? This isn't just theory - this is practical, tactical agentic coding in action. I show you the actual code, the real prompts, and the genuine results. Nine different landing page versions, each created by independent agents working in parallel E2B sandbox environments.

🎯 The agent is the best tool for engineering. The question is: how well can you use it? Master principled AI coding fundamentals, learn tactical agentic coding patterns, and discover how agent sandboxes can 10x your engineering impact.

Stay focused and keep building.
